item.title: UMaine men’s basketball drops to 1-12 after loss to Canisius
item.description: UMaine only scored 17 points in the first half and wound up losing to Canisius 70-43 on Saturday afternoon in Orono.

item.description: PROVIDENCE, R.I. item.title: Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza wins Heisman Trophy
item.description: Fernando Mendoza, the mercurial quarterback of No. 1 Indiana, won the first-ever Heisman Trophy for his school on Saturday night.

item.title: UMaine hockey roars out to early lead in 5-0 win over Lindenwood
item.description: The University of Maine men’s hockey team started fast and never let up on Saturday night en route to a 5-0 win over Lindenwood University.
